features: THX SPATIAL AUDIO+ 7.1.4 SURROUND: Hear every footstep, reload and explosion in a full 360° soundfield. Switch between THX Spatial Audio for games and movies and THX Stereo for clean, natural music playback.

TRI-MODE CONNECTIVITY WITH BLUETOOTH 6.0: Go wireless with the 2.4GHz USB-C dongle, pair over Bluetooth 6.0 with LE Audio, or plug in with the 3.5mm AUX cable. Works with PC, Mac, PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch, mobiles, and Xbox (via 3.5mm on the controller).

SOFTWARE SUPPORT WITH HEAD TRACKING: The THX Spatial Audio+ app gives you a 10-band EQ with Game, Music and Movie presets, a full Parametric EQ, Bass Boost, Voice Clarity and Sound Normalization. Camera Head Tracking keeps sound locked in place as you turn your head.

50MM DRIVERS + GAME & MUSIC MODES: Large 50mm drivers deliver deep bass and crisp highs. Low-latency Game Mode for competitive play, Music Mode for balanced listening, switch with a triple-press of the Mode button.

DETACHABLE ENC MIC, 50HRS BATTERY & RGB: Environmental Noise Cancellation keeps your voice clear, with one-press mic mute. 800mAh battery for up to 50 hours at 60% volume, USB-C charging in 2-3 hours, breathable cushions, on-ear volume wheel and switchable RGB lighting.
